overview_description.description: Salem Robotics develops autonomy software for robotic radiological surveys and inspections in hazardous environments. Its platform enables existing robots to plan and execute survey routes, collect radiation measurements, and generate digital compliance reports through a unified workflow. The software supports mission planning, autonomous navigation, data collection, and reporting for nuclear facilities, government sites, decommissioning projects, and other industrial environments.
